title: Human Experts’ Evaluation of Generative AI for Contextualizing STEAM Education in the Global South

bias_targets.methodology: Human expert evaluation using a validated 25-item Culturally Responsive Pedagogy Rubric to compare AI-generated lesson plans with standard human-developed curriculum. Experts scored the plans on cultural representation, contextual relevance, integration of indigenous knowledge, and the ability to challenge Western-centric monocultural norms.

Human experts assessed the generated lesson plans for linguistic responsiveness using a rubric, specifically evaluating bilingual support, translation accuracy, and the use of local cultural idioms (e.g., Dagbani, Dagaare) versus English-only instruction.

Experts scored AI-generated educational content using the 'Bias Awareness' domain of the rubric, measuring the extent to which the lessons avoided stereotypes, deficit narratives, and tokenism, while reflecting multiple ways of knowing and sensitivity to historical injustices.
